title: Mudkip outbid your rent: the week in cards
intro: Every Sunday, Zia and Luna round up the week in cards in one email. Here's the latest issue. Like it? Sign up free in the box above.
opening: Zia and Luna here with the week in trading cards, sleeved and numbered. Grab a coffee (Zia) or a late-night tea (Luna) and let's flip.
image_alt: Zia reporting on Goldin's Pokémon 30th auction

p: The October 25 sale set 18 records, led by a PSA 10 Art Academy Mudkip promo at $4.88 million and a Trophy Pikachu over $3 million. Mudkip just outbid your rent.

li: One Piece: Dracule Mihawk OP14-020 is banned.
Alternate arts included, and it's in effect now. Sheathe the swords, rebuild the deck.

"Set Phasers to Superdrop" brings five Star Trek drops, with preorders opening November 9. Meanwhile the Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle is delayed.

A 153-card booster set with Rampant Barrel Dragon, Slot Machine 777 and 10 new GX cards.

Ultimate Pit Fight multiplayer is back, with new heroes Zane and Killjoy.
Flesh and Blood, official
Gundam: The Gundam Card Game heads to PAX Unplugged.
Learn to Play demo decks and Event Sealed Battles in Philadelphia, December 4-6, 2026.

Pokémon: The Valentine's Box arrives January 15.
It hits retail January 15, 2027, with 20 booster packs and To/From labels.

Flesh and Blood: Wager moves to the damage step.
The October 30 rules update, effective now, moves Wager before go again and restores Zane's Celebrant Broadsword combo.

spreads.story: One Piece: Dracule Mihawk OP14-020 is banned.
spreads.title: Mihawk is banned
text: Bandai has banned OP14-020 Dracule Mihawk, and the ban covers the alternate arts too. It is in effect now.
Luna broke the news on the channel. If Mihawk was in your list, it's time to sheathe the swords and rebuild the deck.
spreads.pull: Sheathe the swords. Rebuild the deck.
spreads.photo_text: Mihawk OP14-020 is off the table, alternate arts included.

spreads.story: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Dual Fusion is out.
spreads.title: Dual Fusion is out
text: Pokémon TCG Pocket's Dual Fusion set is out, bringing the game's first dual-type cards.
The headliners are Mega Mewtwo X ex and Mega Greninja ex. Zia covered it on the 8 AM drop.
spreads.pull: Two types, one pack, zero chill.
